about: RollSense on REF-MAC (NFR-022, FR-141): a 550-photo sample of the owner's phone roll drawn at random (seed 20261120) in the roll's own mix (252 HEIC, 197 JPG, 101 PNG; names and photos kept out of the repository), on an external USB SSD, the release benches as on the ThinkPad, telemetry every second (no clock or temperature without sudo on Apple Silicon). Swap held at 11.9 GB and did not grow; memory free never under 65 %.
machine: Apple M3 (4 performance + 4 efficiency cores), 16 GB, macOS, mains power, dev app closed

headers.note: roll_scan's per-file time is almost all its hash, a full decode for files without an embedded thumbnail (the app hashes in the pass instead): headers alone are about 1.5 ms a file of CPU, 15,000 in about 3 s on 8 threads
